rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines MUST be uppercase and widely spaced (tracking-[0.2em]).
NEVER center-align dense text or paragraphs. Left-align for authority.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24 for sections to create breathing room.

containers.bento_card_wide: col-span-1 md:col-span-8 bg-white border border-zinc-200 p-8
containers.bento_card_narrow: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 bg-white border border-zinc-200 p-8

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#002FA7] text-white px-8 py-4 font-bold tracking-wide hover:bg-[#00207A] transition-colors duration-200 rounded-none
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 px-8 py-4 font-bold tracking-wide hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors duration-200 rounded-none

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-200/50 backdrop-saturate-150 transition-all duration-300

cards.style: bg-white border border-zinc-200 p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 rounded-none

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and links MUST have visible hover states with higher contrast.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Use framer-motion for smooth fade-up entrances. DO NOT use bouncy or overly playful animations. Keep them sharp and professional (ease-out, duration 0.4s).
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Use lenis for smooth scrolling momentum.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='contact-submit-button'
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Hover states must have higher contrast than default.

section_guidelines.hero: Left-aligned dominant text. Clear value prop. Background should be clean white geometric abstract. Use a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-white/90 via-white/70 to-transparent) to ensure text legibility.
section_guidelines.services: Use the Tetris bento grid mode. Sharp borders (border-zinc-200), no border radius (rounded-none).
section_guidelines.usp_highlight: Create a high-contrast horizontal break. Dark background (#18181B) with stark white text stating 'Interview our engineers before hiring'.
section_guidelines.portfolio: Large imagery. Generous spacing between case studies. Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 for desktop.
section_guidelines.about_us: Include team portrait. Text should convey trust. Add a 'Trusted By' marquee right below this.
section_guidelines.testimonials: Clean typography, use large quotation marks. Incorporate client logos.
section_guidelines.contact: Minimalist form. No rounded corners. Heavy borders on focus (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7] focus:border-transparent).

images.description: Clean white structural frame symbolizing code architecture

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT prompt the user with ANY questions. Build the complete UI based on these guidelines.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind CSS for marketing layouts (Hero, Sections, Bento). Avoid relying solely on rigid pre-built Shadcn structural cards for layouts.
Use Shadcn components ONLY for interactive logic (Forms, Inputs, Selects). Customize Shadcn default rounded borders to rounded-none to fit the aesthetic.
Include an explicit visible navigation bar on desktop (do not hide links inside a mobile hamburger on large screens).
Integrate Google Font 'Outfit' for headings and 'Inter' for body.
NEVER use placeholder text or mock image URLs. Use the provided media URLs exclusively.
Install and use lucide-react for all icons (minimalistic, matching stroke-width).
The USP 'Interview our engineers before hiring' MUST be the focal point of its own distinct, high-contrast section (e.g. inverted colors).
